verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing and accessing one-time passwords, including on Apple Watch. Nothing in the evidence shows TOTP codes being generated fully offline or viewable without a vendor account. Community comments point the other way: they say local, non-cloud vault storage is gone, which suggests an account and sync are expected.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes
